No complete plan-compatible alternative proof is available in this batch.

The SVD conversion from a complete smallest-singular-value limit to positive eigenvalue limits and off-square zero counts is local and recorded in the carrier. The substantive Bai–Yin limit and eventual full-rank supplier remains unresolved.
